business_problem: A.S.O. wanted to engage a broader international audience with personalized Tour de France content and race data, helping fans follow riders and events in ways that conventional broadcasts could not provide.
solution_summary: A.S.O. and Capgemini created Inside My Race, an AI-driven digital experience available through the Tour de France website and mobile app. The service combines more than 20 live and historical data and content feeds, then uses AI agents to produce personalized race narratives and summaries for selected riders, teams, and nationalities. Content is refreshed every two minutes and can include text, statistics, photos, and video. Self-healing AI checks data and moderates output to support timely, accurate updates, while the customer-facing experience lets fans select riders and receive tailored race context. During its first Tour de France deployment, the platform produced about 200 stories every two minutes in four languages for 184 riders. The source does not identify specific model or storage products.

business_outcome: Inside My Race gave fans personalized race narratives and reached over one million visits in its inaugural use. The experience also extended coverage to fans of riders and teams who receive less attention in live broadcasts.
